name: 02026 · Dedham, MA
findings: ZIP 02026 (Dedham) has 145 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02026 (Dedham) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
